Viewport Scaling Disabled

This page has viewport settings that prevent users from zooming:

  • maximum-scale=1.0 - Prevents zooming beyond 100%
  • user-scalable=no - Explicitly disables zooming

Users with low vision rely on zoom functionality to read content. Blocking zoom is a WCAG 1.4.4 failure (Resize Text).

Why This Fails

WCAG requires that users can zoom content up to 200% without assistive technology. The viewport meta tag restrictions prevent this.

Common Problematic Patterns

  • user-scalable=no
  • user-scalable=0
  • maximum-scale=1
  • maximum-scale=1.0

Correct Implementation

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

Simply omit maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions.
